picks.why: Concrete scenarios make human review meaningful without claiming to verify arbitrary programs.
Historical retrieval separates hindsight leakage from forecasting ability, while retaining coverage and judge limits.
Moxie separates a privacy-preserving interface from backend access and treats cryptographic risk as uncertain.
Siren distinguishes boundary crossing from misaligned use and reports mitigation benefits alongside evaluation limits.
A video-model launch exposes the tradeoff between visual polish and eliciting broader pretrained capabilities.
